description: This file coordinates the forking of a worker process, monitors its output, and sets the main process exit code based on the worker's results. It is intended for testing or managing child processes in a Node.js environment using TypeScript syntax.

methods.name: workerProcess.stdout.on('data')
methods.description: Event handler collecting output data from the worker process.

methods.name: workerProcess.on('error')
